sensor.name: Hamamatsu_S13360-6050PE
sensor.parameter_source: Hamamatsu S13360 datasheet KAPD1052E07 (Jul 2025), PDF pp.2-5, T=25 C, overvoltage=3 V. PDE points read approximately from PE curve KAPDB0322EB. Recovery 29 ns transferred from S13360-1350CS/3050CS (Rosado 2018 PDF p.3 Table 1); readout and recovery below 2 V remain approximations. No unit-level calibration.

configuration_notes.purpose: Single-channel GAGG photon-to-electrical response with a named Hamamatsu device.
configuration_notes.geometry: 6 x 6 mm active area centered on existing 10 x 10 mm ideal photon-recording plane. Outside photons are rejected by digitizer, not removed from WaveformEvent. This does not introduce physical epoxy/grease/package geometry.
configuration_notes.status_definition: datasheet_based means manufacturer typical inputs plus explicitly documented approximations, not calibrated performance.
configuration_notes.wavelength_scope: 400-650 nm only, covering current GAGG scintillation table (2.0-3.0 eV). No extrapolation.
configuration_notes.readout: Same uncalibrated demonstrator as v1, except ADC maximum 500 -> 1000 mV.
configuration_notes.adc_range_reason: 2026-10-13 named-device alpha: analog peak 508.01760677599276 mV, 4 clipped samples at 500 mV. See jupyter/artifacts/sipm_native_20261013_095254/summary.json. Preserve v1 and all ROOT files; new range is a project readout choice, not a Hamamatsu specification.

manufacturer.conditions: Ta=25 C; Vop=Vbr+3 V; DCR threshold 0.5 p.e.; PDE excludes crosstalk and afterpulses. Fill factor already included in PDE.

pde.interpolation_assumptions: Use separable spectral/voltage response over 0-3 V. At 2 V scale spectrum by 0.315/0.400. Below 2 V interpolate linearly to zero; not manufacturer-measured low-voltage data or wavelength-dependent recovery.
pde.trigger_scale_V: 2.4 V empirical approximation for non-photon recovery acceptance; not a manufacturer device constant.

recovery.source_title: Performance of SiPMs in the nonlinear region
recovery.author: Jaime Rosado
recovery.limitation: This paper quotes recovery from reference [1]. It does not measure the selected S13360-6050PE. Temperature and unit-level uncertainty not specified; verify selected unit with double-pulse data.

parameter_evidence.dark_rate: 2 Mcps total device, treated as primary Poisson DCR; manufacturer 0.5 p.e. threshold specification, not a measured primary/afterpulse decomposition.
parameter_evidence.crosstalk: 3% manufacturer typical at full recovery; existing recursive one-neighbour candidate model is a simplified distribution.

afterpulse.meaning: Manufacturer describes low afterpulse qualitatively but supplies no probability/delay here. Zero disables this process; it is not a claim that the device has no afterpulses.

transit.meaning: No device-specific SPTR or transit offset supplied; no added jitter in this version.

optical_coupling.meaning: Existing index-matched virtual recording plane retained. Physical epoxy, grease, reflection and collection efficiency require later optical calibration.
